lines.speaker: Mum
lines.english: Hi, Bobby. I want to do the shopping for Mrs Pig.
lines.chinese: 嗨，Bobby。我想去帮猪太太买东西。

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: Can I go with you?
lines.chinese: 我能和你一起去吗？

lines.speaker: Mum
lines.english: Sure.
lines.chinese: 当然可以。

lines.speaker: Mum
lines.english: How was school today?
lines.chinese: 今天在学校过得怎么样？

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: Great! Mrs Fox asked us to write about our heroes.
lines.chinese: 很好！狐狸老师让我们写一写自己的英雄。

lines.speaker: Mum
lines.english: Who do you want to write about?
lines.chinese: 你想写谁呢？

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: A famous scientist or inventor. They work hard and do great things.
lines.chinese: 一位著名的科学家或发明家。他们努力工作，做了伟大的事情。

lines.speaker: Mrs Sheep
lines.english: Hi, Mrs Mouse! Thanks for taking my baby to the park yesterday.
lines.chinese: 嗨，鼠太太！谢谢你昨天带我的宝宝去公园。

lines.speaker: Mum
lines.english: I'm happy to help.
lines.chinese: 我很乐意帮忙。

lines.speaker: Mrs Pig
lines.english: Hi, Mrs Mouse! Thanks for doing the shopping for me every week.
lines.chinese: 嗨，鼠太太！谢谢你每周帮我买东西。

lines.speaker: Mum
lines.english: I'm happy to help.
lines.chinese: 我很乐意帮忙。

lines.speaker: Mum
lines.english: Why are you so happy, Bobby?
lines.chinese: Bobby，你为什么这么高兴？

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: Because I have a good idea for my homework!
lines.chinese: 因为我对作业有了一个好主意！

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: Mum, look at this! You're my hero. Now I know everyone can be great.
lines.chinese: 妈妈，看看这个！你是我的英雄。现在我知道，每个人都可以很伟大。

lines.speaker: Mum
lines.english: Wow! Thank you, Bobby.
lines.chinese: 哇！谢谢你，Bobby。

sections.title: Sounds in focus — 字母组合 ar 的发音 /ɑː/

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Great people are like stars.
lines.chinese: 伟大的人就像星星。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: In the dark, they give light.
lines.chinese: 在黑暗中，他们带来光明。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: With dreams and hard work,
lines.chinese: 怀揣梦想，努力奋斗，

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: You can also shine bright.
lines.chinese: 你也能够闪耀光芒。

lines.speaker: Yuan Longping
lines.english: I have two dreams.
lines.chinese: 我有两个梦想。

lines.speaker: Yuan Longping
lines.english: I want to enjoy the cool under tall rice plants.
lines.chinese: 我想在高高的水稻植株下乘凉。

lines.speaker: Yuan Longping
lines.english: I also want to see hybrid rice grow all over the world.
lines.chinese: 我还想看到杂交水稻在全世界生长。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Who was Yuan Longping?
lines.chinese: 袁隆平是谁？

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Yuan Longping was a Chinese rice scientist.
lines.chinese: 袁隆平是一位中国水稻科学家。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: He was born in 1930 in Beijing.
lines.chinese: 他于1930年出生在北京。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: He passed away in 2021 in Changsha.
lines.chinese: 他于2021年在长沙去世。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: He did a lot of studies on rice.
lines.chinese: 他做了许多关于水稻的研究。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: People call him the father of hybrid rice.
lines.chinese: 人们称他为杂交水稻之父。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: How did his dreams come true?
lines.chinese: 他的梦想是怎样实现的？

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Yuan liked farming at an early age.
lines.chinese: 袁隆平从小就喜欢农业。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: When he grew up, he studied farming.
lines.chinese: 长大后，他学习了农业。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: In 1964, he began to work on hybrid rice.
lines.chinese: 1964年，他开始研究杂交水稻。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: It was very difficult, but he never gave up.
lines.chinese: 这非常困难，但他从未放弃。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: He worked hard and always stayed in the fields.
lines.chinese: 他努力工作，总是待在田里。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: He developed hybrid rice in 1973.
lines.chinese: 他于1973年研制出了杂交水稻。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: Now hybrid rice grows in China and many other countries.
lines.chinese: 如今，中国和许多其他国家都种植杂交水稻。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.english: It feeds people all over the world.
lines.chinese: 它养活了全世界的人们。
